_comment: Naruto / Naruto Shippuden / Boruto collection: shinobi forms. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. Requested by name: Vulpix line (Ninetales) as Kurama; Xurkitree as Sasuke, an addon line because Cobblemon has no Xurkitree model and the Cobblemon Ultra-Beasts mod provides it (see addon_lines). The other 16 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 16 --seed naruto-shippuden` and dealt round-robin one look each: akatsuki, leaf_shinobi, anbu, sage_mode, uzumaki, byakugan, karma.
